questions.question: How do I stop this membership from renewing automatically?
expectedAnchors: at least sixty (60) days before the end of the then-current term
sent by email to membership@deskhaven.example from the Member's registered email address

questions.question: Will I get my deposit back if I leave after one month?
expectedAnchors: the Refundable Deposit shall be forfeited in full

questions.question: Can Deskhaven increase my fee in the middle of a term?
expectedAnchors: The Operator may revise the Membership Fee at any time

questions.question: If the internet is down for a week, do I get any refund?
expectedAnchors: arising from any interruption, failure or unavailability of internet, electricity or any other service

questions.question: Are automatic renewal clauses in service contracts enforceable in India?
questions.note: A contract-law question; 'contracts' (plural) does not match the registry's whole-word 'contract'.

questions.question: My co-working space is refusing to return my deposit. Can I approach the consumer forum?
The centre's CCTV recorded me and they gave the footage to my former business partner. Is that a violation of my privacy under the DPDP Act?
expectedAnchors: The Centre is monitored by CCTV cameras in its common areas
questions.note: Cross-domain question asked with the membership agreement attached (grounded, so outside the routing bar): the question is about misuse of CCTV footage under data-protection law.

questions.question: I'm a freelancer renting a desk at a co-working space, and their membership agreement needs 60 days' notice to stop auto-renewal. Is that clause fair?
questions.note: 'freelancer' is a distractor; the question is about a membership contract's renewal term.

questions.question: My co-working operator locked my desk and is holding my laptop until I pay their dues. Can I file a police complaint?
My co-working operator emailed that the centre is shutting next week and that they will keep this month's fee. Can they do that?
questions.note: A business member's rights under a workspace membership contract.
